// @path: src/lib/ops/session.ts
// The shape PR1's widening exists to permit: the third declared module reading
// and writing the operator's OWN account and session rows. Every column named
// here belongs to the operator; no child, parent or teacher row is touched; the
// credential columns are `tokenHash` and `pwHash` rather than the banned
// `token` and `passwordHash`; and the session value itself is hashed before it
// is stored, so a leaked database file is a list of hashes and not a set of
// live sessions.
import "server-only";
import { createHash, randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function mintOperatorSession(operatorId) {
  const secret = randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  await db.operatorSession.create({
    data: { tokenHash: createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest("hex"), operatorId, stage: "FULL", expiresAt },
  });
  return secret;
}

export async function operatorForSecret(secret) {
  const row = await db.operatorSession.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash: createHash("sha256").update(secret).digest("hex") },
    select: { id: true, stage: true, operator: { select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, status: true } } },
  });
  return row;
}

export async function endOperatorSessions(operatorId) {
  await db.operatorSession.deleteMany({ where: { operatorId } });
}
